The Ni42Fe30Cr12Mn8Al5Ti3 CCA (nominal composition listed in Table 1) was synthesized in the laboratory using pure metals by vacuum arc-melting in Ti-gettered argon atmosphere. The ingots were inverted and remelted five times to ensure chemical homogeneity, followed by casting into a copper mold with dimensions of 8 × 20 × 60 mm3.
The as-cast ingot was solution-treated at 1150 ◦C for 2 h, followed by water cooling.
The homogenized ingot was cold rolled (CR) with a total thickness reduction of 86 %.
